name: diffweb-web
description: diffweb's browser code (web/*.ts), bundled by bun into static/dist/. Dev tooling: type checking and playwright for shot.ts.

scripts.build: bun build web/catalog.ts web/profiles.ts web/worktree.ts web/hud/hud.ts --outdir static/dist --target browser --format=iife --sourcemap=linked
